credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Light-Brown chair with wooden frame and woven thin strips of wood fiber for seat. This seat is a tight grid pattern with no spaces in between rows. Back of chair has three horizontal wooden slats with flat buttons and  curved tops. Left and right sides of bottom of chair have two horizontal rectangular rods each connecting the vertical legs. Front and back of chair bottom has one rounded horizontal rod each to connect vertical legs. Legs are rectangular with tapered bottoms and feet. One of these chairs is in Studio 9 next to fireplace at table (2000.5.778a-b). The other chair is in Studio 9A at writing desk.
title: Chair
